## The claim

The read-derived DeepVariant calls agree with the delivered VCF at the sites where both call.

**Prediction if true.** For every target gene, DeepVariant PASS calls agree with the delivered callset at >= 99% of sites where both callers emit a genotype. Computed after the calls exist — a concordance check, never an input to discovery.

**What would refute it.** Concordance < 99%, in which case every discordant site is listed with its IGV shot and the discovery route is re-examined before anything is concluded from it.
